## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] Hardware-tested with an N200 Pro (or marked untested and explained why)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/PROTOCOL.md) for user-visible or protocol changes
- [ ] No vendor binaries, decompiled output, or proprietary assets included
- [ ] Logs/screenshots have MAC addresses, serials, and personal paths removed
